title: Automatic train repair
author: Kristian432 and ickputzdirwech
description: Stops a damaged train, places repair ghosts (fuel, equipment, filters), restores schedule/group when rebuilt, optionally after refueling, and can request fuel when live trains run empty. Factorio 2.0 fork of ickputzdirwech's Automatic train repair.
